segments.name: Property & Casualty
segments.description: Provides property and casualty insurance products, with loss reserves for long-tail and short-tail coverages.
segments.evidence: There are a number of assumptions involved in the determination of our property & casualty loss reserves.

segments.name: Life & Retirement
segments.description: Holds individual life, annuity and long term care benefit blocks that are in runoff and largely ceded to reinsurers.
segments.evidence: We have legacy blocks of individual life, annuity and long term care benefits that are no longer strategic; these blocks are in runoff and effectively 100% ceded to remove the financial impact to us

segments.name: Supplemental & Group Benefits
segments.description: Sells supplemental and group employee benefit products, including disability, accident and health coverages, to educators and other customers.
segments.evidence: Our supplemental products offer indemnity benefits rather than the reimbursement of actual costs.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay insurance premiums for property and casualty, life and retirement, and supplemental and group benefit coverages, with a portion of risk ceded to reinsurers.
revenueModel.evidence: We retained approximately 73.1% of gross and assumed group disability, life, and specialty health benefits in 2025.
